purpose: gnssmap3 (kernel q10jr5 / 0355, ioctl 123): ONE mapping action per boot after the Wi-Fi read-only guard and a 2 s console pause: control: ml_io_map(0x10006000, 0x1000), one always-on SPM page through io_submap, no access. Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
